settings.text: Everything about how your LUMA order gets to you — and our no-stress returns.

Order processing. Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays). You'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking link as soon as your order ships.

Rates and delivery.

  • Free standard shipping on all orders over $50.
  • Orders under $50 ship at a flat $4.95.
  • Standard delivery: 3–6 business days.
  • Express delivery: 1–3 business days (calculated at checkout).

International. We ship worldwide. International delivery typically takes 7–14 business days. Any customs duties or import taxes are the recipient's responsibility and are not included at checkout.

Tracking. Once shipped, you'll receive a tracking number by email. Please allow up to 48 hours for tracking to begin updating.

Our 30-day glow guarantee. If you're not completely in love, return your items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — even if they're opened. Skincare is personal, and we get it.

How to start a return.

  • Email us at hello@luma.com with your order number and the items to return.
  • We'll send a prepaid return label and simple instructions.
  • Pack the items securely and drop off your parcel using the label provided.

Refunds. Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Damaged or incorrect items. If anything arrives damaged, faulty, or incorrect, email hello@luma.com within 7 days with a photo and your order number. We'll make it right with a replacement or full refund — no return shipping needed.

Questions? Reach our glow team any time at hello@luma.com and we'll reply within 24 hours (Mon–Fri).
